producer.name: ChatGPT Work session AI; original artifacts authored from the retrieved issuer announcement

confidence.basis: Subjective confidence in the scoped announcement reading; no confidence score for investment attractiveness.

summary: Design capacity alone cannot establish financial materiality. Stop before translating it into unsupported cash flows or valuation.

claims.text: Heidelberg Materials announced annual Brevik CCS capture design capacity of around 400,000 tonnes of CO2.
limitations: An issuer design-capacity announcement is not verified annual delivered capture, permanent storage or avoided emissions.
It does not establish realized cement premiums, retained allowance savings, grant proceeds or operating costs.

business_model.analysis: Capture design capacity is a physical project parameter. The announcement does not establish the economic rights and realized cash flows required for a financial bridge.

gaps: Actual captured and permanently stored volumes with period and verification boundary.
Executed grant/support terms, realized premiums, retained allowance economics and operating costs.
Issuer/instrument baseline, shares, current market prices and approved portfolio mandate.

issues.description: Actual captured and stored volumes, realized premiums, executed support terms, retained carbon benefits and operating costs are unavailable in this single-source review.
